system: Ledgerline — multi-tenant invoicing API (fictional; design document only, no code)

scope.selectionCriteria: Every authority-bearing action named in DESIGN.md. Design-doc modality: the control structure is read off the component list and the review notes, so 'full' means every action the document describes — the document itself is the boundary.

sources.note: no codebase exists; all process models are inferred from prose and recorded as assumptions

cells.controlAction: issue a session for a member
cells.ucaTypeLabel: Not providing causes hazard
cells.reason: Failing to provide this action withholds service from a legitimate party. That is an availability loss, and this run is bounded to the confidentiality and integrity losses named in 01-scope.md. Recorded as out of hazard, not unexamined — re-run with an availability loss declared to resolve it.

cells.controlAction: issue a session for a member
cells.ucaTypeLabel: Providing causes hazard
cells.reason: No context of this action places one org's data in another org's response or in an unintended channel. The action operates within a single org scope that the design derives from the caller, and the derivation itself is examined at CA-2.provided rather than repeated here.

cells.controlAction: issue a session for a member
cells.ucaTypeLabel: Wrong timing or order (too early / too late / out of order)
cells.statement: The API gateway mints a session carrying an orgId before membership is confirmed current, leading to H-1 for the token's lifetime.

cells.controlAction: issue a session for a member
cells.ucaTypeLabel: Applied too long or stopped too soon
cells.reason: This action is request-scoped in the design: it completes within one request and establishes no standing grant, so there is no interval over which it can run too long or stop too soon. The two standing grants in this system are the session (CA-6.duration) and the pay link (CA-3.duration), both resolved.
